name: Saved
description: Saved capabilities. Includes Check whether a page can back a heatmap, Create a saved heatmap for a page URL, Get a single saved heatmap by its short_id, including per-width render status., Hard delete of this model is not allowed, List saved heatmaps for the project, Persist screenshots captured client-side by the on-page toolbar as a completed screenshot heatmap, Re-run screenshot generation for a saved heatmap of type 'screenshot', Speculatively render a screenshot for a page URL ahead of heatmap creation, so it's ready (or closer to ready) by the time the user reaches the generation screen, and 1 more.
